svg.title: The Winter Ford, in Nine Depths
svg.desc: A procedural Russian Realist winter plain at a low February sun of 9.5 degrees. Every mark is placed by one pinhole camera at 1.70 metres and one sun; colour is mixed into the horizon haze by exp(-d/380 m). By Dmitri S. Pravdin.

g.text: camera 1.70 m above the plain · f = 1500 px · horizon y = 470
sun altitude 9.5° · azimuth 34° right of axis · shadow = 6.0 h
haze colour mixed toward ##e2d8c2 by 1 - exp(-d/380 m)
